description: This file defines a PHP class ADODB_Cache_MemCache that manages memory caching using Memcache or Memcached extensions within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It handles connection setup, cache read/write, and cache invalidation operations, specifically for persistent memory caching in PHP applications.

classes.name: ADODB_Cache_MemCache
classes.description: Class for handling memory cache operations using Memcache or Memcached in the ADOdb PHP library, including connection management, cache read/write, and server control features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache object with database connection settings, including host, port, compression, and options.

methods.name: isLibMemcached
methods.description: Returns true if the underlying library used is Memcached, false if Memcache.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Lazy connection method that initializes connection to memcache server(s), determining whether to use Memcache or Memcached based on available classes, setting up server controllers, and handling connection failures.

methods.name: writeCache
methods.description: Stores data in the memcache server with a specified filename (MD5 hash) as key, including optional debugging output.

methods.name: readCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached data from memcache server by filename and unserializes the result, handling special timeout logic.

methods.name: flushAll
methods.description: Flushes all cached entries from the memcache server.

methods.name: flushCache
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry identified by filename (MD5 hash) from memcache.
